low.title: Full-Day Vukovar Nature Escape on a Low Budget
low.summary: A peaceful and affordable full-day route through Vukovar’s riverside, parks, and natural viewpoints with low-cost local food.

schedule.title: Danube Riverside Morning Walk
schedule.description: Start your day following the long riverside promenade surrounded by greenery and fresh air.

schedule.title: Park Forest Stroll
schedule.description: Explore one of Vukovar’s small park-forest zones ideal for easy walking and birdwatching.

schedule.title: Nature Photography Time
schedule.description: Spend time taking pictures of trees, river reflections, and open natural spaces.

schedule.title: Low-Cost Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy budget-friendly Slavonian food — simple, tasty, and filling.

schedule.title: Danube Park Relax
schedule.description: Sit under the trees, read, sketch, or simply rest with the sound of the river nearby.

schedule.title: Riverside Path Exploration
schedule.description: Walk further downriver to quieter natural segments with fewer people.

schedule.title: Sunset by the River
schedule.description: End your day watching soft golden colors reflecting on the Danube.

medium.title: Balanced Full-Day Nature Route
medium.summary: A comfortable nature-focused day with riverside walks, parks, and a moderately priced traditional meal.

schedule.title: Coffee with a River View
schedule.description: Start with a warm drink in a café overlooking the Danube.

schedule.title: Danube Promenade Walk
schedule.description: A long walk along the river, exploring its peaceful natural stretches.

schedule.title: Shady Park Area
schedule.description: Relax in a green park — perfect for stretching, sitting, or reading.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: Have a classic Ćobanac-style stew or grilled dish at reasonable prices.

schedule.title: Nature + Heritage Blend
schedule.description: Explore areas where greenery meets historical architecture.

schedule.title: Peaceful Riverside Path
schedule.description: Walk further along lesser-known natural river stretches.

schedule.title: Evening Green Spot
schedule.description: End in a leafy riverside park as the day cools down.

high.title: Premium Nature Day Along the Danube
high.summary: A polished nature-focused day with longer scenic walks, curated natural viewpoints, and high-quality local dining.

schedule.title: Quality Breakfast by the River
schedule.description: Start strong with a well-made breakfast in a scenic location.

schedule.title: Danube Scenic Walk
schedule.description: Walk the most beautiful sections of the riverside, combining nature and silence.

schedule.title: Park + Viewpoint Route
schedule.description: Explore elevated grassy areas with great views of the river.

schedule.title: High-Quality Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy refined Slavonian dishes with beautiful presentation.

schedule.title: Extended Nature Walk
schedule.description: Explore more remote riverbank sections, perfect for photos and quiet time.

schedule.title: Calm Riverside Rest
schedule.description: Sit in a quiet natural corner surrounded by greenery.

schedule.title: Golden-Hour Nature Walk
schedule.description: Experience the dramatic shift of colors as the sun sets over the river.

comfortable.title: Luxury Danube Nature Experience
comfortable.summary: A serene, top-tier nature experience blending scenic riverside routes, premium dining, and calm green spaces.

schedule.title: Luxury Breakfast Overlooking Nature
schedule.description: Start with a premium breakfast and beautiful morning views.

schedule.title: Exclusive Scenic Walk
schedule.description: Walk the most elegant and well-maintained natural parts of the Danube promenade.

schedule.title: Private Green Corners
schedule.description: Find photogenic, quiet nature areas ideal for relaxing and reflection.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Local-Inspired Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy upscale dishes inspired by Slavonian tradition, in an elegant setting.

schedule.title: Premium Park Zone
schedule.description: Stroll through beautifully maintained parks with curated pathways.

schedule.title: Nature + Architecture Blend Spot
schedule.description: Visit scenic zones where heritage buildings meet natural surroundings.

schedule.title: Sunset Nature Finale
schedule.description: End the day with a luxury-style golden-hour Danube view.
